metadata.name: QuadraticIFNeuron
metadata.author: Latham, P.E. et al.
metadata.description: Latham 2000 isolated QIF with normalized numerical apex and repolarization boundaries

extensions.source_equation: dx/ds=x**2+eta from equations (1), (2), and (5a) with x=2(V-M)/DeltaV, s=t/(2*tau_cell), eta=4*I_hat_a/DeltaV-1
extensions.maintained_discretisation: Schema/RTL use explicit Euler at the source timestep; production runtimes use a separately validated exact held-current Riccati flow
extensions.identity_note: sc_symmetric_quadratic_if preserves the historical -1/+1/.01 SC profile
